punchline: Susan Jeffers says fear shrinks when your life stands on many pillars instead of one.
thirty_sec: In Feel the Fear and Do It Anyway, Susan Jeffers notes that many people build their lives around one area, often a relationship or job, so any threat to it feels like losing everything. Her Whole Life Grid divides life into boxes: relationship, family, work, friends, growth, leisure, contribution, time alone. Commit to all of them, and a loss in one hurts but doesn't destroy you.
question: Which area of your life holds too much weight?
